data.title: PR-22A: ADR-0055 build custom incremental engine, with the measured invalidation-precision baseline (bn-13sa + bn-3gf6)

data.body: [MEDIUM] Trace-mode recall silently omits clean-only outputs. `judge` iterates only `revision.records`, so a stale reused parse that suppresses downstream queries counts the parse miss but never counts labels present only in `after_clean`. The cone cross-check cannot expose this because `audit.rs:870-871` also skips a label without an engine record. `trace_mode` then discards each step summary at lines 588-604. The retained golden proves the gap: Die Hard interactive trace has 93 judged labels versus 98 clean labels, and the register has 94 versus 100, yet each records only one experimental miss and 973 per mille recall. The missing 5 and 6 outputs are absent from FN, recall, and retained case evidence. This understates the stale-reuse blast radius in an artifact used as the Phase C regression baseline. Failure modes: an experimental stale parse suppresses clean outputs while aggregate recall stays inflated. Edge cases: both corpora reproduce the omission on sequential heuristic-trap transitions; promotion edits-mode figures are unaffected. Rollback: keep the ADR and Phase C status changes unmerged, or revert them, until the artifact is regenerated. Monitoring: assert `judged_labels + only_in_clean == module_granularity.labels` and retain trace case verdicts. Validation: count and classify clean-only labels, add trace case lines, regenerate the golden, verify the two corrected trace recalls, and rerun the full gate.

data.reason: MEDIUM blocker: trace-mode recall omits 11 clean-only outputs caused by stale Experimental parse reuse. Fix the accounting, retain trace case evidence, regenerate the golden, and re-request this review.

data.body: [RESOLVED] Commit 2730cdf fixes the finding. Failure modes: lines 493-518 count every clean-only output as FN and attribute it to first-divergence blame. Edge cases: both corpus traces now retain case lines at 641-702; promotion and edits modes still have zero clean-only misses. Rollback: keep ADR-0055 and Phase C status unmerged if the pinned artifact diverges. Monitoring: lines 519-523 and 761-792 assert complete label accounting, zero strong FN, and promotion isolation. Validation: the locked precision_baseline test and cargo fmt pass; traceability regeneration is byte-identical. The dossier self-test passes, while its jsonschema validator could not run because this sandbox cannot fetch the missing package.

data.reason: 2730cdf counts clean-only labels as FN, retains trace cases, corrects recall, and passes the focused gate.
